nifty.label: Nifty 50 closing level
nifty.note: Official end-of-day close published by NSE Indices. Updated after market close.
nifty.source: NSE Indices Ltd (niftyindices.com), Historical Data report

pe.label: Nifty 50 P/E (price to earnings)
pe.note: Published daily by NSE Indices. From 31 Mar 2021 the P/E uses consolidated earnings (earlier: standalone), so P/E before and after that date is not like-for-like (it fell from 40.4 to 33.2 overnight). P/B and dividend yield did not change basis.
pe.source: NSE Indices Ltd (niftyindices.com), Historical Data report

pb.label: Nifty 50 P/B (price to book)
pb.note: Published daily by NSE Indices. From 31 Mar 2021 the P/E uses consolidated earnings (earlier: standalone), so P/E before and after that date is not like-for-like (it fell from 40.4 to 33.2 overnight). P/B and dividend yield did not change basis.
pb.source: NSE Indices Ltd (niftyindices.com), Historical Data report

dy.label: Nifty 50 dividend yield
dy.note: Published daily by NSE Indices. From 31 Mar 2021 the P/E uses consolidated earnings (earlier: standalone), so P/E before and after that date is not like-for-like (it fell from 40.4 to 33.2 overnight). P/B and dividend yield did not change basis.
dy.source: NSE Indices Ltd (niftyindices.com), Historical Data report

vix.label: India VIX (expected volatility)
vix.source: NSE Indices Ltd (niftyindices.com), Historical Data report
vix.note: NSE's measure of how much the market expects Nifty to move over the next 30 days. Higher = more nervous.

repo.label: RBI policy repo rate
repo.source: Reserve Bank of India homepage, 'Current Rates'
repo.note: Date shown is the date we read it from the RBI site.

usdinr.label: USD/INR reference rate
usdinr.source: FBIL reference rate, as shown on RBI homepage
usdinr.note: Set once a day around 1:30 pm IST.

usdinr_hist.label: USD/INR (ECB cross rate), daily history
usdinr_hist.source: European Central Bank reference rates via Frankfurter API
usdinr_hist.note: Used for history and back-tests; the FBIL rate is used for today's figure.

cpi.label: India CPI inflation (all-India, combined), year on year
cpi.note: Official monthly CPI, released around the 12th of the next month. History accumulates from each refresh.

us10.label: US 10-year government bond yield
us10.source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (series DGS10)
us10.note: Official US Treasury data via the Federal Reserve, 1-3 day lag.

brent.label: Brent crude oil price
brent.source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (series DCOILBRENTEU)
brent.note: US EIA daily Brent spot price via FRED, a few days' lag.

in10.label: India 10-year government bond yield (monthly)
in10.source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (series INDIRLTLT01STM)
in10.note: Monthly average of the benchmark 10-year G-sec yield (OECD, from RBI data), via FRED. Published with a lag of a few weeks; date = month.

dii.label: Domestic institutions (DII) net flow in the cash market, provisional
dii.note: Provisional, one trading day; NSE's site often refuses automated requests, so days can be missing. History accumulates from each refresh.

fii.label: Foreign (FII/FPI) net flow in the cash market, provisional
fii.note: Provisional, one trading day; NSE's site often refuses automated requests, so days can be missing. History accumulates from each refresh.
